question: How much leave was accrued or granted for someone with two years of continuous service in 2023, and what had it become by 2025?

members.why: explains which of the three accrual versions applies to which date range
oldest version, in force until 2024-07-01, covers the 2023 date; two years is in the 1-year-and-over bracket = 15 days
second version, in force 2024-07-01 to 2025-12-31, covers the 2025 date; needs type+tenure
maps 'two years' of continuous service to tenure code T2, used to read the v2 table
